title: Radial stochastic coordinate with restoring drift
summary: A positive radial coordinate undergoes Ito diffusion with a restoring drift and unit Brownian noise.
invariant: The source stochastic generator is specified by drift and quadratic variation.
controls: omit quadratic variation when changing coordinates

assumptions: Dimensionless variables and standard scalar Ito Brownian motion.
Positive coordinate, theta and alpha; local C2 observables.

title: Two-spin longitudinal interaction
summary: A two-spin Hamiltonian couples longitudinal Pauli components; transverse magnetization evolves through a correlation.
invariant: Finite-dimensional unitary evolution preserves density-matrix trace and positivity.
variables: rho: density matrix on two spin-1/2 factors
controls: remove the correlation from a reduced description

assumptions: Closed two-spin dynamics; hbar=1 and positive g.
Every initial density matrix is admissible.
